title: Which royal relations?
hook: Whose authority does the royal letter describe?

knows: Selected accounts can describe distinct institutions and dated changes.
doesNotKnow: Kongo institutions and Portuguese colonial establishment as different histories

objective: Kongo institutions and Portuguese colonial establishment as different histories

claims.text: The Met identifies Afonso’s royal exchange with Manuel, while Angola’s timeline describes Portuguese colonial establishment at Luanda and a governor’s flight amid regional resistance. A request between rulers is not surrender of Kongo government. These are different institutions and mediated histories, not empty land, one merged Kongo/Ndongo polity or evidence of general consent.
